statements.text: According to G.O.Ms.No.27, only the Government can sanction works, including emergency works, costing above Rs.1.00 crore.
statements.quote: Works (including emergency works) costing above Rs.1.00 crore – Government only.

statements.text: Alternatively, under Circular Memo No.USD01-WRKS0/9/2023, the Commissioner is authorized to accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore.
statements.quote: As per Circular Memo No.USD01-WRKS0/9/2023, Dt.11-07-2023 (Flag B), the Commissioner may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.
